name: Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsunomanika Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken: Memorial Vacation
original_name: お隣の天使様にいつの間にか駄目人間にされていた件 Memorial Vacation
source:
Amane happens to be the next-door neighbor to the school's most beautiful girl, Mahiru, which is known by the nickname "Angel".
As they spend time together, their relationship changes from "next-door neighbors" to "lovers".

And then came their first summer vacation.

The story of this game begins in summer, when, by sheer luck, Mahiru wins tickets to a trip to Okinawa.
translation:
天音恰好是学校最美丽的女孩真昼的隔壁邻居，真昼有着“天使”的绰号。
随着时间的推移，他们的关系从“邻居”变成了“恋人”。

然后他们的第一个暑假到来了。

这款游戏的故事始于夏天，真昼凭借运气赢得了冲绳之旅的门票。
